Human Neuroscience

Radboud University

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

Study how the human brain supports cognition and behaviour, combining biological and psychological knowledge with mathematics, programming, data analysis and neurotechnology. Research projects develop experimental and academic skills.

The published requirements do not yet establish a complete curriculum for a reliable programme comparison. The supported allocation is shown below; UCR alternatives are withheld.

Academic year: 2026–2027

External pathway: Supported allocation; later years still in development

The degree is 180 EC. The published allocation accounts for 164 EC, including 60 EC of provisional second-year learning lines. The remaining 16 EC and the final later-year course structure are not established. This is a partial allocation, not a complete degree pathway.
